_about: Plain-English notes on why some product × method combinations show >50% deviation between our calculated score and ADEME's published Agribalyse reference. Every remaining gap traces back to characteristics of the underlying inventory data or to a documented methodology difference with ADEME's published synthese, not to calculation errors in our pipeline. 16 of 19 impact categories carry zero outliers.

climate.short: No data gaps. Matches ADEME within ±8%.

cc_fos.short: No data gaps. Matches ADEME within ±9%.

cc_luc.short: No data gaps. Matches ADEME within ±30%.

energy.short: No data gaps. Matches ADEME within ±9%.

land.short: No data gaps. Matches ADEME within ±30%.

ht_c.short: Same activities, mappings, and elementary flows as ADEME. A handful of high-leverage CFs in bw2io's EF v3.1 snapshot differ from the EF revision ADEME used, producing a +4.3% mean bias library-wide (max +41.5%, no SKU above ±50%).

mater.short: No data gaps. Matches ADEME within ±3%.

ecotox.short: Same activities, mappings, and elementary flows as ADEME. A few elementary-flow CFs in bw2io's EF v3.1 snapshot differ from ADEME's EF revision, producing a +6.5% mean bias (max 46.5%, no SKU above ±50%) — same shape as ht_c.

pm.short: No gaps. The earlier −51% fishing-vessel cluster came from elementary flows with empty sub-compartment that weren't mapped to the unspecified-UUID biosphere row; the biosphere-mapping fix closed it.

e_fw.short: No gaps. The earlier −82% pangasius outlier closed via the same biosphere-mapping fix as PM.

water.short: EF v3.1 has no CF for the "natural resource" water flows used by aquaculture and tropical fruit. The bundle patches with regional AWARE × net consumption — but GLO/RoW activities fall back to CF = 7 m³/m³ (seafood under-scores ~−97%), while Asia/Africa picks up high regional CFs (tropical fruit over-scores +150 to +230%).

ht_nc.short: Same activities, mappings, and elementary flows as ADEME. One pesticide elementary flow's CF in bw2io's EF v3.1 snapshot differs from ADEME's EF revision; Tamarin pulpe lands at +51% on that single CF.

acid.short: Same activities, mappings, and elementary flows as ADEME. NH3 from the seasoning supply chain is divided by a larger reference unit in ADEME's synthèse (perennial-crop allocation applied after the activity-level inventory); Carottes râpées avec sauce lands at +63% without that scaling.
